The song got a lot of play in the clubs.

glosses: A button that, when pressed, causes media to be played.

examples.text: press play

glosses: An instance of wordplay.

examples.text: play on words
The name Wiktionary is a play on the words wiki and dictionary.

glosses: Activity relating to martial combat or fighting.

examples.text: handplay, swordplay

glosses: To exploit (a potential weakness or vulnerability) by exacerbating.

examples.text: to play on someone's fears

glosses: To exploit (a double meaning, similarity in sound, etc.) for humorous or creative effect.

examples.text: This joke plays on the fact that 'thirsty' sounds similar to 'Thursday'.

glosses: To impinge upon in a recurring or nagging way.

examples.text: to play on one's mind, or conscience

glosses: To frequently allude to or return to as a theme.

examples.text: The pamphlet plays on the idea that all social conflict is class-based.

glosses: to hit the ball into his own wicket, thus being out bowled
To let the game continue after a foul has been committed, because the situation is advantageous to the team who would be awarded a foul.
To cause (an opposing player) to be onside rather than offside due to one's position on the field of play.

examples.text: The ref said that Smith was offside, but I think that Jones played him on.

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see play, on.

examples.text: I knew I was losing, but I played on anyways.

glosses: Alternative form of play on (certain senses).
przegrać
zagrać / odegrać (wykonać w całości)
stracić na czymś

examples.text: Кто выиграл, а кто проиграл от падения рубля?
examples.translation: Kto zyskał, a kto stracił na spadku rubla?

glosses: grać (spędzić czas na grze, grając w coś)
bawić się (spędzić czas na zabawie, bawiąc się w coś)

examples.text: Вместе они могут весь день проиграть в прятки и в догонялки."
examples.translation: Razem oni / one mogą bawić się cały dzień w chowanego i berka.

glosses: Perdre.

examples.text: Коммуняки готовы использовать против нас все методы, и если мы будем бороться с ними в белых перчатках, мы проиграем.
examples.translation: Les cocos sont prêts à utiliser toutes les méthodes contre nous, et si nous les combattons avec des gants blancs, nous perdrons.

glosses: 輸；失敗

examples.text: проигра́ть па́ртию в ша́хматы
проигра́ть суде́бный проце́сс
Пье́са проигра́ла от плохо́й режиссу́ры.

glosses: 扮演；表演；演奏
